title: echinops pungens var. transcaucasicus
intro: Echinops pungens var. transcaucasicus, commonly known as Caucasian globe thistle, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help protect against chronic diseases like cancer and cardiovascular disease. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and serve as a natural antihistamine. The bioactive constituents of Caucasian globe thistle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
